name: Zephyr Coredump
description: The `zephyr_coredump` component helps debug crashes on [nRF52](https://esphome.io/components/nrf52/) devices without a debug probe. When the firmware crashes, Zephyr saves the CPU registers and the stacks of all threads to a 32 KB partition at the top of the application flash. After the restart the stored dump is printed in the log as hex-encoded `#CD:` lines and then erased. The Zephyr coredump tools turn that log into a GDB session with a full backtrace.
